scope: Selected CLI source, documentation, original mark and non-privileged tests. No private workspace, credentials, helper, OS configuration or original Git history. Modified by fanctl contributors on 2026-11-07 to validate controller data, preflight targets, and attempt diagnosed, bounded best-effort automatic recovery. Modified on 2026-11-15 to wait for thermal-manager handoff, recognize system-controlled automatic mode, and show measured before/after RPM with bounded terminal progress, signal recovery and existing sudo-cache reuse without password storage. Modified to create the system cache through native sudo askpass and support strictly noninteractive authorization. Modified on 2026-11-19 to read status directly and make motor observation optional after verified control. Interactive terminals also show a width-aware per-fan tachometer.
runtime: On one Mac, identical CLI source was tested with a temporary fan target and return to automatic mode. Recovery after a write failure was only simulated; other Macs are unverified. On 2026-11-19 the revised status path read both fans on one Mac without elevation. Changes, optional observation and recovery were exercised with a synthetic controller.
